expected.title: Nonvanishing Zhu C2 images of singular vectors in noncritical universal affine vertex algebras of complex simple Lie algebras
expected.author: Tomoyuki Arakawa; Cuipo Jiang; Anne Moreau
expected.difficulty_reason: The nonvanishing of the Zhu image is not a formal consequence of the associated graded invariant ring, whose singular arc-polynomials can have positive depth. The author combines the commutative highest-weight reduction with a carefully chosen PBW monomial and an explicit Sugawara commutator expansion that controls its root and Cartan factors. The noncritical-level coefficient then rules out the proposed leading-term cancellation and forces zero depth, which is the nonroutine obligation behind the selected singular-vector statement.

material.preserved_editorial_scope:
\paragraph{Editorial problem boundary.}
Prove only Theorem 1.2 below for a finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra and noncritical level \(k\ne-h^\vee\): every nonzero singular vector of the universal affine vertex algebra has nonzero image in its Zhu \(C_2\)-algebra. The entire authored commutative reduction and noncommutative Sugawara/PBW cancellation argument is retained, including its printed bounded ancillary PBW checks. Critical-level, superalgebra and arbitrary singular arc-polynomial assertions are outside this item.
